The game itself is in Finnish. Play it in the browser at
[lukuloitsu.fi](https://lukuloitsu.fi), or download it below for Windows,
macOS or Linux. `lukuloitsu-opas.pdf` is the printable user booklet (in
Finnish): how the system works, examples, and all the pairs with their
pictures.

None of the downloads is code-signed, so your computer may warn about them.

**Windows:** unzip `lukuloitsu-windows.zip` and run `lukuloitsu.exe`. Chrome
may warn about the download (choose **Keep**) and Windows may say "Windows
protected your PC" (choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**).

**macOS:** unzip `lukuloitsu-macos.zip` and move `Lukuloitsu.app` to
Applications. It runs on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs (macOS 11 or
newer). The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**, then **Open**
again; or, if macOS says it can't check the app, open **System Settings →
Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.

**Linux:** unpack `lukuloitsu-linux.tar.gz` (`tar xzf lukuloitsu-linux.tar.gz`)
and run `lukuloitsu/lukuloitsu`. It needs a 64-bit x86 desktop with ALSA
sound, X11 and OpenGL, which practically every distribution has, and glibc
2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 or newer).

You can also build it yourself; see the README.
